title: Family Law Part 1: Nikah ke Sharaait
summary: Bohat se log nahi jante ke Nikah ko qanoon ki nazar mein durust banane ke liye kya zaroori hai. Agar aap ke ghar mein kisi ka Nikah hone wala hai to ye batein samajhna lazmi hai.
content:
FAMILY LAW SERIES | Hissa 1 az 10

Bohat se log nahi jante ke Nikah ko qanoon ki nazar mein durust banane ke liye kya zaroori hai. Agar aap ke ghar mein kisi ka Nikah hone wala hai to ye batein samajhna lazmi hai.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Pakistan mein Hanafi qanoon ke mutabiq Nikah ek civil contract hai. Durust Nikah ke liye chahiye: (1) ijab o qubool, yani offer aur acceptance ek hi mehfil mein, (2) contract ke waqt do gawah maujood hon, (3) biwi ke liye haq mehr tay ho, aur (4) dono fareeq ki razamandi aur qanuni haisiyat ho, aur rishta mamnoo darjon mein na ho.

AHM NUQTA: Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 ke tehat Nikah ka registration alag lazmi zimmedari hai. Registration khud Nikah ko durust nahi banati, lekin is ke baghair aap adaalat mein apni shaadi sabit karne mein sakht mushkil ka samna karenge. Durust hona aur register hona do alag qanooni sawalat hain. Is series ke Part 2 mein Nikahnama tafseel se samjhaya gaya hai.

AAM GHALTI: Log taqreeb ko contract samajh lete hain. Bari taqreeb jahan proper ijab, qubool aur gawah na hon, qanoon ki nazar mein us sada Nikah se kamzor hai jahan ye shartein poori hon.

Hawala: Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 (mukammal amended text): https://www.sja.gos.pk/assets/Updated_Laws/The_Muslim_Family_Laws_Ordinance_1961.pdf

title: Family Law Part 2: Nikahnama
summary: Nikahnama sirf ek form nahi hai. Ye paband karne wala qanooni contract hai, aur September 2026 mein Supreme Court ne poori qaum ko is ke bare mein ek ahm yaad-dihani karai hai.
content:
FAMILY LAW SERIES | Hissa 2 az 10

Nikahnama sirf ek form nahi hai. Ye paband karne wala qanooni contract hai, aur September 2026 mein Supreme Court ne poori qaum ko is ke bare mein ek ahm yaad-dihani karai hai.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Column 13 se 16 mehr ke liye hain. Column 13 mein mehr ki raqam likhi jati hai, jo koi bhi jayez qeemti cheez ho sakti hai. Column 14 mein tay hota hai ke kitna mehr prompt (muajjal) hai aur kitna deferred (muwajjal). Column 15 mein likha jata hai ke shaadi ke waqt mehr ka kitna hissa ada hua. Column 16 mein mehr ke badle di gayi jaidad ki mukammal tafseel aur tay shuda qeemat darj hoti hai.

WO COLUMN JO LOG CHHOR DETE HAIN: Column 17 khas sharaait ke liye hai, jaise ikhtelaf ki surat mein monthly kharcha, biwi ki rehaish, us ka taleem ya mulazmat jari rakhne ka haq, aur jahez ki ashya. Column 18 talaq-e-tafweez ke liye hai, jahan shohar biwi ko muqarar sharton par talaq ka ikhtiyar de deta hai. Column 19 mein shohar ke apne talaq ke haq par pabandiyan likhi jati hain.

MAUJUDA QANOON: September 2026 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ke mehr biwi ka enforceable qanooni haq hai, us ki "qeemat" nahi. Column 13 se 16 ko mila kar parha jaye, alag alag nahi. Adaalat ne Nikah Registrar ko paband kiya ke sign lene se pehle entries dono fareeqon ko parh kar samjhaye, khas taur par mehr, khas sharaait, delegated talaq aur mehr ki jaidad, aur koi column baghair wajah khali na chhore.

AAM GHALTI: Column 17 aur 18 ko baghair baat cheet ke cross kar ke sign kar dena. Sign ke baad ye entries durust tasleem ki jati hain, aur inhein challenge karne ke liye mazboot saboot darkar hota hai. Shaadi se pehle ye shartein tehreer mein tay karwana aap ka haq hai.

Hawala: SC mehr/Nikahnama faisla (Tribune): https://tribune.com.pk/story/2630802/supreme-court-rules-dower-is-a-wifes-enforceable-right-not-her-price

title: Family Law Part 3: Talaq ka Qanooni Tareeqa
summary: Sirf talaq kehne se Pakistan mein shaadi khatam nahi hoti. Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 ki Section 7 ek bilkul wazeh qanooni tareeqa muqarrar karti hai, aur is se hatna jurram hai.
content:
FAMILY LAW SERIES | Hissa 3 az 10

Sirf talaq kehne se Pakistan mein shaadi khatam nahi hoti. Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 ki Section 7 ek bilkul wazeh qanooni tareeqa muqarrar karti hai, aur is se hatna jurram hai.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Jo shaks kisi bhi soorat mein talaq de, use foran Chairman Union Council ko tehreeri notice dena hoga aur biwi ko us notice ki copy deni hogi. Talaq us waqt tak effective nahi hoti jab tak notice Chairman ko milne ke din se 90 din na guzar jayein, jab tak is muddat mein wapas na le li jaye.

PROCEDURE: Notice milne ke 30 din ke andar Chairman Arbitration Council banata hai jo dono mein sulah ki koshish karta hai. Agar biwi hamila hai to talaq 90 din ya hamal ke khatme ke baad effective hogi, jo baad mein ho. Effectiveness ke baad Chairman certificate of effectiveness of divorce jari karta hai, jis ki buniyad par NADRA computerized divorce certificate deta hai.

SAZA: Notice na bhejne par ek saal tak qaid, paanch hazaar rupay tak jurmana, ya dono ho sakte hain.

AAM GHALTI: Ek hi baar mein teen talaq de kar samajhna ke teenon talaqain poori ho gayin. Ordinance ke scheme ke tehat 90 din ka tareeqa effectiveness ko control karta hai, aur adaaltein ek mauqa par di gayi teen talaqon ko ek effective talaq qarar deti hain jo is muddat mein wapas li ja sakti hai.

title: Family Law Part 4: Khula Procedure in Pakistan
summary: Khula aur DMMA 1939 ki statutory dissolution alag remedies hain. Family Courts Act 1964 filing, service, reconciliation, trial aur decree ka framework deta hai.
content:
FAMILY LAW SERIES | Hissa 4 az 10

PROCESS OF KHULA IN PAKISTAN

Khula aur Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act 1939 ke tehat statutory dissolution ko ek samajhna durust nahi. Sahi legal ground pleading, evidence aur dower ke nateeje ko affect kar sakta hai.

JURISDICTION: West Pakistan Family Courts Act 1964 ki Section 5, Schedule ke sath parhi jaye, Family Court ko dissolution of marriage, including khula, par exclusive jurisdiction deti hai.

PLAINT AUR DOCUMENTS: Section 7 ke mutabiq plaint mein material facts, witnesses ki list aur relied-on documents diye jate hain. Jo document plaintiff ke qabze mein na ho, us ki list aur relevance state ki jati hai.

SUMMONS: Section 8 defendant ki service aur written statement ke process ko govern karti hai.

RECONCILIATION: Section 10 pre-trial proceedings mein compromise ya reconciliation ki koshish ko address karti hai. Agar reconciliation fail ho to Family Court applicable statutory text aur current provincial amendments ke mutabiq case proceed karti hai.

TRIAL AUR DECREE: Section 12 evidence ke baad further reconciliation effort, judgment aur decree se relevant hai. Agar biwi Section 2, Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act 1939 ki statutory ground plead kare to us ground ka proof relevant hota hai.

SECTION 2 DMMA 1939: Is section mein shohar ka chaar saal se la-pata hona, do saal maintenance na dena, qaid, marital obligations perform na karna, impotence, specified illness, cruelty aur Muslim law ke tehat recognised grounds shamil hain. Exact clause facts ke mutabiq identify hoti hai.

DOWER / HAQ MEHR: Har dissolution ko khula keh dena theek nahi. Khula aur statutory dissolution ke dower consequences mukhtalif ho sakte hain. Court ko pleadings aur evidence ke mutabiq relief decide karna hota hai.

FEES: Is guide mein koi fixed court fee, lawyer fee ya certificate fee quote nahi ki gayi. Current court fee, process cost aur professional fee filing se pehle relevant Family Court aur service provider se written form mein confirm karein.

Exact legal references: Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act 1939, Section 2. West Pakistan Family Courts Act 1964, Sections 5, 7, 8, 10 and 12, read with the Schedule and current Sindh amendments.

Ye general legal information hai. Case-specific facts ke liye currently enrolled lawyer se advice lena munasib hai.

title: Family Law Part 5: Tanseekh-e-Nikah (DMMA 1939)
summary: Pakistan mein bohat si khawateen nahi jantin ke qanoon unhein adaalat ke zariye shaadi khatam karne ki 9 makhsoos wajuhat deta hai. Ye mukammal qanooni fehrist hai, aam zuban mein samjhai gayi.
content:
FAMILY LAW SERIES | Hissa 5 az 10

Pakistan mein bohat si khawateen nahi jantin ke qanoon unhein adaalat ke zariye shaadi khatam karne ki 9 makhsoos wajuhat deta hai. Ye mukammal qanooni fehrist hai, aam zuban mein samjhai gayi.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act 1939 ki Section 2 ke tehat Muslim qanoon ke mutabiq shaadi shuda aurat in wajuhat par dissolution ki decree le sakti hai: (1) shohar ka pata 4 saal se maloom na ho; (2) 2 saal se kharcha na diya ho; (2A) shohar ne Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 ki khilaf warzi kar ke doosri shaadi ki ho; (3) shohar 7 saal ya zyada qaid ho, saza final honi chahiye; (4) 3 saal se baghair jayez wajah azdawaji faraiz ada na kiye hon; (5) shaadi ke waqt na-mard ho aur ab tak ho; (6) 2 saal se deewana ho ya khatarnak jinsi beemari ho; (7) option of puberty, yani sarparast ne 15 saal se pehle shaadi ki ho aur larki 18 saal se pehle, hambistari se pehle, shaadi se inkar kar de; (8) zulm, jis mein aadatana maar peet, buri auratyon se talluq, ghair ikhlaqi zindagi par majboor karna, us ki jaidad bech dena, mazhabi ibadat mein rukawat, ya biwiyon mein na-insafi shamil hai; (9) Muslim qanoon ke tehat koi bhi aur jayez wajah.

PROCEDURE: Biwi Family Court mein dissolution ka dawa dayer karti hai, apni wajah saboot se sabit karti hai, aur adaalat decree deti hai. Lapata shohar wali wajah par decree 6 mah baad effective hoti hai taake use hazir hone ka mauqa mile.

AAM GHALTI: Samajhna ke aurton ke liye sirf khula ka rasta hai. 1939 ke Act ki statutory wajuhat aksar mazboot rasta hain, khas taur par jahan shohar qasoorwar ho, kyunke ye biwi ka mehr mehfooz rakhti hain.

Hawala: Dissolution of Muslim Marriages Act 1939, Section 2. Mukammal text: https://www.courtkutchehry.com/bare-acts/dissolution-of-muslim-marriages-act-1939/

title: Family Law Part 6: Haq Mehr
summary: Haq mehr koi tohfa ya ehsaan nahi hai. Pakistan ke family law mein ye biwi ka enforceable qanooni haq hai, aur September 2026 mein Supreme Court ne ye baat dobara wazeh kar di hai.
content:
FAMILY LAW SERIES | Hissa 6 az 10

Haq mehr koi tohfa ya ehsaan nahi hai. Pakistan ke family law mein ye biwi ka enforceable qanooni haq hai, aur September 2026 mein Supreme Court ne ye baat dobara wazeh kar di hai.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Haq mehr wo raqam ya jaidad hai jo shohar biwi ko Nikah ke contract ke tehat dene ka paband hai. Prompt mehr (muajjal) demand par ada hota hai. Deferred mehr (muwajjal) talaq ya shohar ki wafat par ada hota hai. Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 ki Section 10 ek ahm default deti hai: jahan Nikahnama mein adaigi ke tareeqe ki tafseel na ho, poora mehr demand par ada shuda tasleem hota hai.

WASOOLI: Biwi Family Court mein mehr ki wasooli ka dawa kar sakti hai, aur decree shohar ki jaidad se execute hoti hai. Jahan jaidad mehr mein likhi gayi lekin muntaqil nahi hui, shohar us ki tay shuda qeemat ka zimmedar rehta hai, ya adaalat us waqt ki market value tay karti hai.

MAUJUDA QANOON: September 2026 mein Supreme Court ne kaha ke mehr biwi ka enforceable haq hai, us ki "qeemat" nahi, aur Nikahnama ke mehr wale columns ko mila kar parha jaye. October 2025 mein Adaalat ne kaha ke khula lene wali aurat shaadi ke waqt ke tamam zewar aur mehr ki ashya ki haqdar hai. Adaaltein ab dissolution ke cases mein biwi ka mehr khamoshi se khatam nahi kar saktin.

AAM GHALTI: Dikhawa ke liye ghair haqiqi bara deferred mehr likhwana, ya mehr ka column mubham chhor dena. Mubham column ka matlab Section 10 ke tehat poora mehr demand par ada. Raqam aur tareeqa tehreer mein tay karwayein.

Hawala: Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961, Section 10: https://www.sja.gos.pk/assets/Updated_Laws/The_Muslim_Family_Laws_Ordinance_1961.pdf | SC mehr faisla (Tribune): https://tribune.com.pk/story/2630802/supreme-court-rules-dower-is-a-wifes-enforceable-right-not-her-price

title: Family Law Part 7: Naan-Nafqa (Maintenance)
summary: Kya shohar is liye kharcha dene se inkar kar sakta hai ke rukhsati nahi hui? Supreme Court of Pakistan ne 2026 ke ek landmark faislay mein is sawal ka jawab de diya hai.
content:
FAMILY LAW SERIES | Hissa 7 az 10

Kya shohar is liye kharcha dene se inkar kar sakta hai ke rukhsati nahi hui? Supreme Court of Pakistan ne 2026 ke ek landmark faislay mein is sawal ka jawab de diya hai.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Ambreen Akram vs Asad Ullah Khan (2026 SCMR 1, faisla 11 September 2025, Justices Syed Mansoor Ali Shah aur Aqeel Ahmed Abbasi) mein Adaalat ne kaha ke biwi ke kharche ka haq Nikah se hi shuru hota hai. Ye rukhsati, hambistari, ya farmabardari se mashroot nahi hai. Rukhsati ki qanoon mein koi alag haisiyat nahi hai.

BOJH E SABOOT: Agar shohar kharcha dene se inkar kare to use wazeh aur mazboot saboot se sabit karna hoga ke biwi ne baghair wajah rishta khatam kiya hai. Adaalat ne purane "farmabardari ke badle kharcha" (ihtibas) tasawwur ko Quran ke Nikah ke tasawwur ke khilaf qarar diya jo muhabbat aur shafqat par mabni hai, aur faislay ki buniyad Constitution ke Articles 14, 25 aur 35 par rakhi.

IDDAT KA KHARCHA: Ye zimmedari talaq par khatam nahi hoti. Biwi talaq ke baad iddat ki muddat mein kharche ki haqdar hai, yani teen mahwari, ya agar hamila hai to waza hamal tak. Ye usi kharcha ke dawe mein Family Court se manga jata hai.

AMLI NUQTA: Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 ki Section 9 ke tehat biwi Chairman ko darkhwast de sakti hai, jo Arbitration Council bana kar kharche ki raqam muqarrar karta hai, jo land revenue ke baqayajat ki tarah wasool hoti hai.

Hawala: Ambreen Akram vs Asad Ullah Khan, 2026 SCMR 1 (Dawn): https://www.dawn.com/news/1941362

title: Family Law Part 8: Bachon ki Custody
summary: Haal hi mein ek viral dawa tha ke doosri shaadi par maa se bachon ki custody khud ba khud cheen li jati hai. Pakistan ki Supreme Court ne 2026 ke faislay mein is ghalat fehmi ko khatam kar diya hai, j
content:
FAMILY LAW SERIES | Hissa 8 az 10

Haal hi mein ek viral dawa tha ke doosri shaadi par maa se bachon ki custody khud ba khud cheen li jati hai. Pakistan ki Supreme Court ne 2026 ke faislay mein is ghalat fehmi ko khatam kar diya hai, jo har walidain ko parhna chahiye.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Guardians and Wards Act 1890 ki Section 17 ke tehat sarparast muqarrar karte waqt adaalat bache ki welfare ko rehnuma banati hai. Welfare sab se aala ghor hai, dono walidain ke technical dawon se upar.

MAUJUDA QANOON: 2026 ke faislay (Justices Mansoor Ali Shah aur Aqeel Ahmed Abbasi) mein Supreme Court ne 7 aur 8 saal ke do bachon ki custody maa ke paas barqarar rakhi. Adaalat ne kaha: bacha walidain ke faislon ka ghair faal wasool kuninda nahi, balkay faael haq-dar hai jis ki awaz suni jani chahiye; maa ki fitri dekhbhal aur jazbati mustaqil mizaji ka koi mutabadil nahi; maa ki mulazmat us ki ehliyat kam nahi karti, ye us ki mazbooti zahir karti hai; aur dono ne doosri shaadi ki thi lekin sirf doosri shaadi ne kuch faisla nahi kiya. Baap ko bachon se mulaqat (visitation) ke huqooq mile.

PROCEDURE: Custody Guardians and Wards Act 1890 ke tehat Guardian Court mein darkhwast de kar mangi jati hai. Adaalat bache ki umar, sehat, taleem, jazbati talluq, har walid ki salahiyat, aur bacha itna bara ho ke raye de sake to us ki pasand dekhti hai, phir custody aur ghair custodial walid ke liye mulaqat ka schedule tay karti hai.

AAM GHALTI: Samajhna ke custody ek khaas umar par khud ba khud baap ko mil jati hai, ya mulazim maa kamzor custodian hoti hai. Qanoon sirf ek sawal poochta hai: is bache ki welfare kis mein hai.

title: Family Law Part 9: Dusri Shaadi ki Ijazat
summary: Baghair Arbitration Council ki ijazat ke doosri shaadi Pakistan ke family law ka sab se ghalat samjha jane wala hissa hai. Nateeje bohat sakht hain, aur January 2026 mein Supreme Court ne is par ek ah
content:
FAMILY LAW SERIES | Hissa 9 az 10

Baghair Arbitration Council ki ijazat ke doosri shaadi Pakistan ke family law ka sab se ghalat samjha jane wala hissa hai. Nateeje bohat sakht hain, aur January 2026 mein Supreme Court ne is par ek ahm faisla bhi diya hai.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961 ki Section 6 kehti hai ke koi mard maujuda shaadi ke dauran Arbitration Council ki pehle se tehreeri ijazat ke baghair doosri shaadi nahi kar sakta. Baghair aisi ijazat ki gayi shaadi Ordinance ke tehat register bhi nahi hogi.

PROCEDURE: Shohar Chairman ko darkhwast deta hai jis mein wajuhat aur ye bayan karta hai ke pehli biwi ki razamandi hasil hui hai ya nahi. Chairman dono taraf se numainday mangwata hai, aur Arbitration Council ijazat sirf tab deta hai jab mutmain ho ke majooza shaadi zaroori aur munsifana hai.

NATEEJE: Jo mard baghair ijazat doosri shaadi kare use maujuda biwi ya biwiyon ka poora mehr, prompt ya deferred, foran ada karna hoga, jo land revenue ke baqayajat ki tarah wasool hoga. Conviction par maujuda amended text ke tehat ek saal tak qaid aur jurmana ho sakta hai. January 2026 mein Supreme Court ne isi lazmi tareeqe par amal na hone ki wajah se ek shaadi khatam kar di.

AAM GHALTI: Samajhna ke ghair registered doosri Nikah "shumar nahi hoti". Shaadi ek haqiqat ke taur par maujood ho sakti hai, lekin mehr aur faujdari nateeje registration se qata nazar lagte hain.

Hawala: Muslim Family Laws Ordinance 1961, Section 6 (amended text): https://www.sja.gos.pk/assets/Updated_Laws/The_Muslim_Family_Laws_Ordinance_1961.pdf

title: Family Law Part 10: Child Marriage (Sindh)
summary: Sindh Pakistan ka pehla suba tha jis ne larkon aur larkiyon dono ke liye shaadi ki kam az kam umar 18 muqarrar ki, aur saza aksar logon ke andaze se kahin zyada sakht hai.
content:
FAMILY LAW SERIES | Hissa 10 az 10

Sindh Pakistan ka pehla suba tha jis ne larkon aur larkiyon dono ke liye shaadi ki kam az kam umar 18 muqarrar ki, aur saza aksar logon ke andaze se kahin zyada sakht hai.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Sindh Child Marriages Restraint Act 2013 ke tehat child har wo shakhs hai, larka ya larki, jo 18 saal se kam umar ka ho. Jahan koi fareeq child ho wo child marriage hai.

SAZAEN: 18 se bara mard jo child marriage kare, use 2 se 3 saal sakht qaid aur jurmana ho sakta hai. Jo shakhs child marriage parhaye, karwaye ya us mein sahulat de, use bhi 2 se 3 saal sakht qaid aur jurmana hoga. Walidain ya sarparast jo child marriage ko farogh de, ijazat de, ya laparwahi se rokne mein nakam rahe, unhein 2 se 3 saal sakht qaid aur jurmana hoga, aur bache ke zimmedar shakhs ke khilaf qanooni mafrooza hoga.

PROCEDURE: Ye jurram qabil e giraftari, ghair zamanati aur ghair sulah-pazeer hai. Koi bhi shakhs judicial magistrate ko shikayat kar sakta hai, aur adaalat 90 din mein trial mukammal karegi.

FARQ: Purane federal Child Marriage Restraint Act 1929 mein larki ki umar sirf 16 thi. Sindh ne jan boojh kar sab ke liye 18 ka mayar buland kiya.

title: Consumer Courts Sindh
summary: Cheated by a shopkeeper? Sold a defective product? Harmed by a doctor's negligence? Most people do not know there is a direct forum for exactly this: the Consumer Court.
content:
Cheated by a shopkeeper? Sold a defective product? Harmed by a doctor's negligence? Most people do not know there is a direct forum for exactly this: the Consumer Court.

The Sindh Consumer Protection Act, 2014 (Sindh Act XVII of 2015) sets up a Consumer Court in every district under Section 27. Section 26 lets you claim damages, and selling a fake product can mean 2 years in prison or a fine of Rs 100,000.

For law students, PLD 2022 Sindh 430 is the landmark holding. The Sindh High Court held that medical services fall within the definition of "services", so a patient can approach the Consumer Court directly. A prior decision of the Healthcare Commission is not required, and the Consumer Court can award damages. Watch the limitation: Section 29 time-bars stale claims, and 2026 SHC KHI 1181 has kept that strictness intact.

For the public: keep your receipts and evidence safe, and file your claim in time.

summary: "The police won't write my FIR." It is Pakistan's most common complaint, and the solution is already written in the law.
content:
"The police won't write my FIR." It is Pakistan's most common complaint, and the solution is already written in the law.

Section 154 of the CrPC makes registering an FIR in a cognizable offence a duty of the police, not a favour. A refusal is a violation of the law itself.

For law students: Sections 22-A and 22-B of the CrPC provide the remedy. An application is filed before the Justice of Peace (the District and Sessions Judge or the Additional District and Sessions Judge), who can order the registration of the FIR. The superior courts have repeatedly held that registration of an FIR is mandatory on information of a cognizable offence. This is the most-used remedy in criminal procedure, and every practitioner must know how to draft it.

For the public: if the police station refuses, call 1715, the IGP Complaint Cell, and report "FIR not registered" along with your CNIC number. There is also an online portal: igpcms.sindhpolice.gov.pk.

title: 2026 SCMR 1
summary: Can a wife be denied maintenance simply because rukhsati has not taken place?
content:
Can a wife be denied maintenance simply because rukhsati has not taken place?
The Supreme Court of Pakistan has given a clear, historic answer in Ambreen Akram vs Asad Ullah Khan.

In 2026 SCMR 1, the Court held that a wife's right to maintenance (nan-o-nafqa) attaches with the nikah itself. It is not conditional on rukhsati, consummation, or obedience. Rukhsati has no independent legal status under the law. The Court further held that if a husband refuses to pay maintenance, he must prove with clear and strong evidence that the wife has wholly and without cause brought the relationship to an end.

For law students, this judgment is a masterclass: the application of Articles 14, 25, and 35 of the Constitution to family law, gender-sensitive judicial language, and the institutional use of amicus curiae. For every citizen, the message is plain: no woman in Pakistan can be deprived of this fundamental right.

The Court also rejected the old "maintenance for obedience" concept of ihtibas, holding it against the Quranic vision of nikah built on affection and compassion.

Case: Ambreen Akram vs Asad Ullah Khan, 2026 SCMR 1. Supreme Court of Pakistan, decided 11 September 2025. Bench: Syed Mansoor Ali Shah and Aqeel Ahmed Abbasi, JJ.

On 1 kilogram, the maximum sentence is 7 years, so the prohibitory clause of Section 497 CrPC was not attracted. Bail is the rule, and jail is the exception.

For law students, study the prohibitory clause of Section 497 CrPC, the quantity table in Section 9(c) of the CNSA, and the classical bail jurisprudence. The Court also held that a tenant's claim of ownership through a declaration suit does not stop eviction unless a decree is obtained. title: Inheritance Law (1/7): Virasat bantne se pehle ye 3 kaam lazmi hain
summary: Walid ka inteqal hua aur ghar walon ne foran jaidad taqseem kar li? Rukiye. Qanoon kehta hai virasat bantne se pehle teen kaam lazmi hain: tajheez o takfeen, qarzon ki adayegi, phir wasiyat, aur phir taqseem.
content:
INHERITANCE LAW SERIES | Hissa 1 az 7

Walid ka inteqal hua aur ghar walon ne foran jaidad taqseem kar li? Rukiye. Qanoon kehta hai virasat bantne se pehle teen kaam lazmi hain, aur inhein chhor kar ki gayi taqseem durust nahi.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Hanafi qanoon ke mutabiq marhoom ki jaidad is tarteeb se niptayi jati hai. Pehle tajheez o takfeen ka munasib kharcha ada hoga. Phir marhoom ke tamam qarze ada kiye jayenge, waris qarze ada kiye baghair jaidad taqseem nahi kar sakte. Teesre number par wasiyat aati hai, jo kul jaidad ke ek tihai se zyada par moassar nahi hoti. In teenon ke baad jo bache, wo warison mein un ke muqarar hissay ke mutabiq taqseem hoga. Yehi tarteeb Quran mein Surah An-Nisa (4:11-12) mein bayan hui hai: taqseem wasiyat ya qarz ke baad hoti hai.

PAKISTAN MEIN QANOON: Pakistan mein virasat ke muqadmaat ka faisla Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) ke mutabiq hota hai, West Pakistan Muslim Personal Law (Shariat) Application Act 1962 ke tehat. Koi riwaj ya khandani rawaj is Shariat ke usool ko khatam nahi kar sakta.

AAM GHALTI: Log qarze aur wasiyat ko nazar andaz kar ke foran taqseem kar lete hain. Baad mein qarz khwah aa jaye to har waris apne hissay ki had tak zimmedar hota hai, aur ghalat taqseem par jhagra saalon chalta hai.

title: Inheritance Law (2/7): Wasiyat sirf ek tihai tak, waris ke haq mein nahi
summary: Meri tamam jaidad mere ek bete ke naam. Kya aisi wasiyat qanoon ki nazar mein chalegi? Jawab: nahi, Hanafi qanoon mein Musalman sirf ek tihai hissa ghair waris ko wasiyat kar sakta hai.
content:
INHERITANCE LAW SERIES | Hissa 2 az 7

Meri tamam jaidad mere ek bete ke naam. Kya aisi wasiyat qanoon ki nazar mein chalegi? Jawab: nahi, aur is ki wajah samajhna har ghar ke liye zaroori hai.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Hanafi qanoon mein Musalman apni khalis jaidad ka sirf ek tihai hissa wasiyat ke zariye kisi ghair waris ko de sakta hai. Baqi do tihai lazmi tor par warison mein taqseem hoga. Kisi waris ke haq mein ki gayi wasiyat doosre warison ki ijazat ke baghair invalid hai, chahe wo ek tihai ke andar hi kyun na ho. Ye usool Privy Council ke mashhoor faisle Ghulam Muhammad v. Ghulam Hussain (1932 PC 81) mein tay hua, jo aaj bhi Pakistani adaalaton mein binding precedent hai. Agar wasiyat ek tihai se zyada ki ho to wo us had tak moassar hogi jis ki waris wafat ke baad ijazat dein. Wazeh rahe ke ye ijazat wasi ki zindagi mein nahi, us ki wafat ke baad di jana zaroori hai.

AAM GHALTI: Log samajhte hain ke wasiyat likh dene se waris ko poori tarah mehrum kiya ja sakta hai. Qanoon is ke bilkul bar aks hai: wasiyat ka maqsad ghair waris (jaise koi rishtedar jo waris nahi, ya falaahi kaam) ke liye ek tihai tak gunjaish dena hai, warison ke haq cheenna nahi.

Hawala: Ghulam Muhammad v. Ghulam Hussain, 1932 PC 81 (Privy Council)

title: Inheritance Law (3/7): Betiyon ka hissa, Quran aur Supreme Court ka faisla
summary: Beti ko rukhsat ke naam par virasat se mehrum kar dena Pakistan ka sab se aam aur sab se ghalat rawaj hai. Surah An-Nisa (4:11) mein hissay muqarar hain, aur July 2026 mein Supreme Court ne is par mohar laga di hai.
content:
INHERITANCE LAW SERIES | Hissa 3 az 7

Beti ko rukhsat ke naam par virasat se mehrum kar dena Pakistan ka sab se aam aur sab se ghalat rawaj hai. Quran ka hukm is par bilkul wazeh hai, aur July 2026 mein Supreme Court ne is par mohar laga di hai.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Surah An-Nisa (4:11) mein hissay muqarar hain. Do ya zyada betiyan hon to unhein kul jaidad ka do tihai milega. Akeli beti ho to us ka hissa aadha hai. Agar bete bhi hon to har beti ko bete ke hissay ka aadha milega. Ye hissay Allah ke muqarar karda hain, koi khandani faisla, dabao ya riwaj inhein khatam nahi kar sakta.

SUPREME COURT, JULY 2026: Do alag faisalon mein adaalat ne qaraar diya ke jhoote zabani tohfe (oral gifts), fareb par mabni transfer, khandani dabao ya riwaj aurat ko virasat se mehrum nahi kar sakte. Virasat ka haq maut ke waqt hi waris ko muntaqil ho jata hai. Jo shakhs dawa kare ke marhoom ne use zabani tohfa diya tha, use ye sabit karna hoga, aur adaalatein aurat ko mehrum karne wali har transaction ko sakhti se jancheingi. Koi jirga ya riwaj Islami qanoon e virasat par ghalib nahi aa sakta.

AAM GHALTI: Betiyon se khushi se dastakhat lekar hissa maaf karwana. Dabao mein liya gaya aisa dastakhat adaalat mein nahi tikta, aur dhoke se aurat ko virasat se mehrum karna PPC 498-A ke tehat jurm hai.

title: Inheritance Law (4/7): Biwi aur shohar ka virasat mein hissa
summary: Surah An-Nisa (4:12) ke mutabiq bewah ka hissa: aulad ho to 1/8, aulad na ho to 1/4. Shohar ka hissa: aulad ho to 1/4, na ho to 1/2. Ye hissa haq mehr se alag hai.
content:
INHERITANCE LAW SERIES | Hissa 4 az 7

Shohar ke inteqal ke baad biwi ko ghar se nikal dena, ya biwi ke inteqal par shohar ka hissa dabaa lena. Dono suraton mein qanoon ka jawab ek hai, aur wo Surah An-Nisa mein likha hai.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Surah An-Nisa (4:12) ke mutabiq bewah ka hissa is par munhasir hai ke marhoom ki aulad thi ya nahi. Agar aulad ho (beta ho ya beti) to biwi ko kul jaidad ka aathwan hissa (1/8) milega. Agar aulad na ho to biwi ka hissa chautha (1/4) hoga. Isi tarah agar biwi ka inteqal ho to shohar ko, aulad ki maujoodgi mein chautha hissa (1/4), aur aulad na hone ki surat mein aadha hissa (1/2) milega. Ye hissay qarze aur wasiyat ki adayegi ke baad banti hui khalis jaidad mein se hain.

AHM NUQTA: Biwi ka ye hissa us ke haq mehr se alag hai. Agar shohar ne mehr ada nahi kiya tha to wo mehr marhoom ka qarz hai, jo taqseem se pehle biwi ko ada hoga, aur phir us ke ilawa biwi ko upar bataya gaya virasat ka hissa bhi milega.

AAM GHALTI: Log biwi ke virasat ke hissay ko kharcha ya ehsaan samajhte hain. Ye ehsaan nahi, us ka muqarar qanooni haq hai jo maut ke waqt hi usay muntaqil ho jata hai.

Hawala: Surah An-Nisa (4:12)

Aulad na hone ki surat mein baap baqi bachi hui jaidad ka waris banta hai. Ghor karein: maa baap dono ko 1/6 milne ka usool sirf us waqt hai jab marhoom ki aulad ho, warna hissay mukhtalif hain.

content:

Main apni beti ko jaidad se aaq kar dunga. Ye jumla Pakistan ke hazaaron gharon mein bola jata hai. Qanoon is ka jawab deta hai: aaq karne se virasat ka haq khatam nahi hota.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Waris ko wasiyat ke zariye mehrum nahi kiya ja sakta. Kisi waris ke haq mein ki gayi wasiyat doosre warison ki ijazat ke baghair invalid hai (Ghulam Muhammad v. Ghulam Hussain, 1932 PC 81). Zindagi mein diya gaya asli tohfa (hiba) alag cheez hai aur durust hai, lekin July 2026 mein Supreme Court ne wazeh kiya ke aurat ko mehrum karne ke liye banaye gaye jhoote zabani tohfe aur farebi transfer adaalatein khatam kar dengi. Aise har transaction ko sakhti se jancha jayega.

JURM BHI HAI: Anti-Women Practices law ke tehat Pakistan Penal Code ki dafa 498-A mein aurat ko dhoke se us ki virasat se mehrum karna jurm hai, jis par 10 saal tak qaid aur 10 lakh rupe tak jurmane ki saza ho sakti hai. Yani ye sirf deewani jhagra nahi, faujdari case bhi ban sakta hai.

AAM GHALTI: Beti ya biwi se zabardasti maafi nama likhwa lena. Dabao mein liya gaya dastakhat adaalat mein nahi tikta, aur aisa karne wala khud mujrim ban sakta hai.

title: Inheritance Law (7/7): NADRA succession certificate ka paanch step tareeqa
summary: Walid ke inteqal ke baad bank account ya plot transfer karwana hai? Pehle succession certificate chahiye hoga. Achhi khabar: ab is ke liye saalon adaalat ke chakkar nahi katne parte, NADRA paanch steps mein jari karta hai.
content:
INHERITANCE LAW SERIES | Hissa 7 az 7

Walid ke inteqal ke baad bank account ya plot transfer karwana hai? Pehle succession certificate chahiye hoga. Achhi khabar: ab is ke liye saalon adaalat ke chakkar nahi katne parte.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Letters of Administration and Succession Certificates Act 2020 (aur Sindh mein Sindh ka 2021 ka Act) ke tehat NADRA apne Succession Facilitation Units ke zariye succession certificate jari karta hai. Tareeqa paanch steps mein hai. Pehle: darkhwast, apna CNIC, marhoom ka death certificate aur affidavit ke sath. Doosre: tamam warison aur jaidad ki tafseel darj hoti hai. Teesre: tamam warison ki biometric verification, jo mulk ke kisi bhi NADRA centre par ho sakti hai. Chauthe: akhbar mein ishtehar de kar 14 din tak awam se aitrazat mange jate hain. Panchwen: agar koi aitraz na aaye to certificate print kar ke de diya jata hai, aam tor par chand hafton mein. August 2025 se ye sahulat mulk ke tamam NADRA centres par dastiyab hai.

AHM SHART: Ye rasta sirf tab hai jab tamam waris mutafiq hon. Agar warison mein ikhtelaf ho, koi waris nabaligh ho, ya koi haqeeqi tanaza ho to NADRA inkar kar dega aur muamla Succession Act 1925 ke tehat adaalat mein jayega. Fee waqt ke sath badalti rehti hai, is liye raqam NADRA se confirm karein.

AAM GHALTI: Ghalat document par apply kar dena. Bank account ke liye succession certificate aur jaidad ke liye letter of administration hota hai. Pehle bank ya registry office se confirm kar lein ke unhein kaun sa document chahiye.

title: Jamshed Rashid v. The State: Supreme Court se pre-arrest bail ke do usool
summary: FIR mein naam baad mein supplementary statement se dala gaya? Supreme Court ne June 2026 mein wazeh kar diya: ye kamzor saboot hai. Do usool: authenticated official record ko nazar andaz nahi kiya ja sakta, aur parity par bail milegi.
content:
FIR mein aap ka naam baad mein, ek supplementary statement ke zariye dala gaya hai? Supreme Court ne June 2026 mein wazeh kar diya: ye kamzor saboot hai, aur adaalat is par aankhein band nahi kar sakti.

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Jamshed Rashid v. The State mein Supreme Court ke do rukni bench (Justice Jamal Khan Mandokhail aur Justice Irfan Saadat Khan) ne Lahore High Court Multan Bench ka order khatam kar ke pre-arrest bail de di. Adaalat ne do usool tay kiye. Pehla: bail ke stage par authenticated official record, jaise travel documents, ko nazar andaz nahi kiya ja sakta. Agar official record kehta hai ke mulzim waqea ke waqt mulk mein tha hi nahi, to adaalat is saboot ko ignore nahi kar sakti. Doosra: asal FIR ke bajaye baad mein di gayi supplementary statement mein naam dalna kamzor evidence hai, jab tak is ki pusht par independent saboot na ho.

PARITY KA USOOL: Teen shareek mulziman ko pehle hi bail mil chuki thi, is liye adaalat ne barabari ke usool par darkhwast guzar ko bhi pre-arrest bail di. Yani jo relief ek ko mil chuka ho, wohi relief barabar ke case mein doosre ko bhi milna chahiye.

AAM GHALTI: Log samajhte hain ke FIR mein naam aa jane ka matlab giraftari ya saza pakki hai. Aisa nahi hai. Agar aap ko dushmani ki bina par jhooti FIR mein phansaya gaya hai to official record aur waqt par qanooni mashwara aap ka sab se bara hathyar hai.

content:

Adaalat ne qaraar diya ke qanoon e shahadat ke tehat agreement ki bunyad par malkiyat ka dawa karne wale ko agreement ke gawahon ko adaalat mein pesh karna hoga. Gawah pesh na karne ki surat mein dawedar ke khilaf adverse inference liya jayega, yani adaalat samjhegi ke gawah pesh na karna dawedar ke nuqsan mein hai. Sath hi adaalat ne kaha ke CDA ke record mein darj third-party rights ko nazar andaz nahi kiya ja sakta, adaalat ko sirf zahiri qanuni pehlu nahi, tamam haqaiq dekhne honge.

AAM GHALTI: Pakistan mein lakhon log plot aur makaan sirf stamp paper par lete dete hain, baghair gawahon aur proper title transfer ke. Ye faisla kehta hai ke adaalat mein aisa agreement akela aap ko malik sabit nahi karega. Khareed se pehle title verify karwayein, gawah rakhein, aur transfer ka proper record banwayein.

title: Pakistan ki jailon mein 73% under-trial: Prison Data Report 2024
summary: Pakistan ki jailon mein har 4 mein se 3 qaidi aise hain jin par abhi koi jurm sabit nahi hua. 102,026 qaidi, 152.2% overcrowding, aur Karachi Central Jail mein 354.92% overcrowding.
content:
Pakistan ki jailon mein har 4 mein se 3 qaidi aise hain jin par abhi koi jurm sabit nahi hua. Ye adaalat ki nakami nahi to aur kya hai?

QANOON KYA KEHTA HAI: Justice Project Pakistan ki Prison Data Report 2024 ke mutabiq Pakistan ki 128 jailon (AJK aur GB samet) mein 102,026 qaidi hain, jo official gunjaish se 152.2% zyada hai. In mein se 73.41% under-trial hain, yani un ka trial abhi mukammal nahi hua aur wo baghair saza ke qaid hain. 2017 mein ye sharah 66% thi, ab barh kar 73.41% ho gayi hai, jab ke aalmi ausat sirf 27% hai. Karachi Central Jail mein 2,400 ki gunjaish ke muqable mein 8,518 qaidi hain, yani 354.92% overcrowding. Saza yafta qaidiyon ki tadaad 3,646 death-row par hai, halan ke December 2019 se koi phansi nahi hui.

MASLA KAHAN HAI: Justice Mansoor Ali Shah ke hawale se Dawn ki report ke mutabiq Pakistan ki adaalaton mein 2.2 million se zyada cases pending hain, jin mein se taqreeban 55,941 sirf Supreme Court mein hain. Trial mein saalon lagne ka matlab hai ke gharib mulzim baghair saza ke apni zindagi, rozgar aur khandan se door saal guzar deta hai. Speedy trial har mulzim ka bunyadi haq hai.

Kiraye par rehte hain? Ye aik line aap ke bohat kaam ki hai.

Section 13, Sind Rented Premises Ordinance 1979 kehta hai: koi kirayedar us ke qabze se sirf is Ordinance ke tehat nikala ja sakta hai. Matlab makan malik khud faisla kar ke aap ko nahi nikal sakta, use Rent Controller se eviction order lena lazmi hai.

Aam ghalti: log malik ki dhamki ya dabao mein aa kar ghar khaali kar dete hain, halanke qanoon aap ke sath hai. Agar malik zabardasti kare to Rent Controller se ruju karein.

title: Shehla Zia vs WAPDA: ek khat jo Pakistan ki tareekh ka ahem faisla bana
summary: Islamabad mein grid station lagne se rokne ke liye likha gaya ek khat Supreme Court ka landmark faisla ban gaya. Court ne wazeh kiya ke Article 9 ke right to life mein saaf aur sehatmand mahol ka haq bhi shaamil hai.
content:
Sirf ek khat ne Supreme Court ko hila diya.

Ek shehri ne Supreme Court ko khat likha aur Islamabad mein lagne wala grid station ruk gaya. Wo khat Pakistan ki tareekh ke sab se ahem faislon mein se ek ban gaya: Shehla Zia vs WAPDA (PLD 1994 SC 693).

Supreme Court ne faisla diya ke Article 9 ke tehet right to life mein saaf aur sehatmand mahol ka haq bhi shaamil hai. Articles 9 aur 14 ko mila kar Court ne kaha: zindagi ka matlab sirf jeena nahi, izzat, sehat aur sukoon ke saath jeena hai. Court ne precautionary principle lagaya: ehtiyat ilaaj se behtar hai, aur scientific uncertainty awam ki sehat ko khatre mein dalne ka jawaz nahi.

Ye faisla Justice Saleem Akhtar ne tehreer kiya aur aaj bhi Pakistan ke environmental law ki bunyaad hai. Pollution, smog aur shehri mansubah bandi ke cases mein aaj bhi isi faisle ka hawala diya jata hai.

title: Atif Zareef vs The State: two-finger test ghair-aaini qarar
summary: Supreme Court ne 2021 mein two-finger test ko ghair-aaini aur ghair-qanuni qarar de diya. Court ne kaha ke is test ki koi scientific value nahi, aur ye rape survivor ki dignity (Article 14) ki khilaf warzi hai.
content:
Ek rape survivor se kabhi poocha gaya tha ke wo virgin hai ya nahi.

Supreme Court ne kaha: ab kabhi nahi.

Atif Zareef vs The State (PLD 2021 SC 550, faisla 4 January 2021) mein Supreme Court of Pakistan ne two-finger test ko ghair-aaini aur ghair-qanuni qarar de diya. Court ne wazeh kaha ke is test ki koi scientific value nahi: hymen ki halat se ye sabit nahi hota ke rape hua ya nahi. Kisi survivor ko is test se guzarna uski dignity (Article 14) aur Constitution ke Article 4(2)(a) ke tehet tahaffuz ki khilaf warzi hai.

Faisla is se aage gaya. Court ne hukm diya ke adaalatein rape survivors ke liye 'habituated to sex', 'woman of easy virtue' ya 'non-virgin' jaise alfaaz istemal karna band karein, chahe ilzam sabit na bhi ho. Trial mein mulzim hai, mutasira nahi.

title: Giraftari ke 24 ghante: police aapko baghair magistrate ke nahi rakh sakti
summary: Article 10(2) aur CrPC Section 61 wazeh hain: har giraftar shakhs ko giraftari ke 24 ghante ke andar magistrate ke samne pesh karna lazmi hai. Is muddat ke baad baghair magistrate ke hukum hirasat ghair-qanuni hai.
content:
Pakistan mein police giraftar karke aapko 24 ghante se zyada nahi rakh sakti. Zyada tar log ye haq jante hi nahi.

Constitution ka Article 10(2) aur Criminal Procedure Code 1898 ki Section 61 wazeh hain: har giraftar shakhs ko giraftari ke 24 ghante ke andar magistrate ke samne pesh karna lazmi hai. Is muddat ke baad magistrate ke hukum ke baghair hirasat ghair-qanuni hai.

Article 10(1) do aur tahaffuz deta hai: giraftari ki wajah jald az jald batana lazmi hai, aur aapko apni pasand ka wakeel rakhne aur mashwara karne ka haq hasil hai.

Agar investigation ke liye aur waqt chahiye to police ko Section 167 CrPC ke tehet remand lena hoga, aur magistrate ko wajah tehreer mein darj karni hogi. Remand istisna hai, usool nahi.

title: Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Bill 2026: muddat khatam, kursi barqarar?
summary: 14 September 2026 ko Sindh Assembly ne manzoor kiya: council ki muddat khatam hone par outgoing mayor administrator ki haisiyat se kaam karta rahega. Jamaat-e-Islami ne Sindh High Court mein challenge kar diya hai.
content:
Karachi ka mayor apni muddat khatam hone ke baad bhi kursi par reh sakta hai. Sindh Assembly ne isay qanoon bana diya.

14 September 2026 ko Sindh Assembly ne Sindh Local Government (Amendment) Bill 2026 manzoor kiya. Is ki sab se mutnazia shiq: council ki muddat khatam hone par outgoing mayor ya chairman administrator ki haisiyat se kaam karta rahega jab tak naya muntakhib sarbarah charge na le. Deputy mayor council ka convener banega.

Opposition ne aiwan mein ehtijaj kiya aur bill ki copies phaad di. Jamaat-e-Islami ab Sindh High Court gaya hai, uska moaqif hai ke ye amendment Constitution ke Article 140A ki khilaf warzi hai jo muntakhib numaindon ko ikhtiyarat ki muntaqili ka taqaza karta hai. Case pending hai.

Ye Karachi, Hyderabad aur Sindh ke har zila ko seedha mutasir karta hai. Adaalat ka faisla jo bhi ho, ye shiq tab tak nafiz rahegi jab tak khatam na ho ya mansookh na ki jaye.

title: Khwateen ka jaaidad ka haq: 60 din mein insaaf ka rasta
summary: Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act 2020 ke tehet Ombudsperson jaaidad se mehrum khawateen ki complaint par karwai karta hai. Complaint ke 60 din ke andar faisle ko tarjeeh di jati hai.
content:
Jaaidad se mehrum khawateen ko civil court mein saalon intezar ki zaroorat nahi. 60 din ka rasta mojood hai jise aksar log jante hi nahi.

Enforcement of Women's Property Rights Act 2020 ke tehet Ombudsperson kisi bhi aisi khawateen ki complaint par karwai kar sakta hai jise uski jaaidad se mehrum kiya gaya ho. Tariqa seedha hai: Ombudsperson muamla Deputy Commissioner ko bhejta hai jo 15 din mein inquiry karke report deta hai. Complaint ke 60 din ke andar faisle ko tarjeeh di jati hai. Phir police aur district administration uska qabza aur title wapas dilane ke paband hain, aur koi adaalat Ombudsperson ke orders ke khilaf stay nahi de sakti.

Agar khawateen khud complaint na kar sake to koi bhi shakhs ya NGO uski taraf se complaint kar sakta hai. Senate ne ye bill 14 February 2020 ko manzoor kiya tha.
